# Real Property Planning

Real Property Planning is a free, independent educational hub for probate real estate, inherited and trust-owned property, estate valuation, and senior housing transitions in Washington State. It publishes 90+ plain-language guides, 10+ calculators, a statewide adult family home directory (AFH Club), and a directory of independent Washington professionals. The hub itself holds no licenses and provides no brokerage, appraisal, legal, tax, or advisory services.

## Who it is for
Executors, trustees, heirs, and families dealing with an estate property; seniors and families planning a move out of a longtime home; adult family home owners, buyers, and operators; and the attorneys, CPAs, financial planners, and care professionals who serve them.

## The featured professionals
When a property decision calls for licensed help, the hub connects visitors with its featured Washington real estate broker and its featured certified residential appraiser, who work independently through their own practices (currently David Stein: broker with eXp Realty, license #133972; appraiser through Stein Appraisal, license #1702080). Brokerage and appraisal services are provided by that person, not by Real Property Planning. The featured roles can change; the guides do not depend on who holds them.

## Topics covered
- Probate and estate property sales in Washington, including court authority, timelines, and as-is versus prepared sales
- Trust-owned real estate and trustee duties
- Date-of-death and estate valuation, appraisal vs. CMA
- Senior transitions, downsizing, and paying for care
- Adult family homes: licensing, buying, selling, financing, and a statewide directory

## Coverage
All of Washington State, with county and city guides; deepest coverage of King, Snohomish, Pierce, Kitsap, and Skagit Counties.

## Adult Family Homes (AFH Club)
"Adult family home" is Washington State's licensing term for a residential home licensed by DSHS to care for up to six (occasionally eight) adults. Other states use different terms for the same model — adult foster home (Oregon, Michigan), residential care facility for the elderly (California), assisted living home (Arizona), personal care home (Georgia, Pennsylvania), family care home (North Carolina).

AFH Club is Real Property Planning's section for families choosing a home and for operators buying, selling, licensing, or running one. It includes a statewide directory of every licensed adult family home in Washington, all 39 counties (6,069 homes, 35,306 licensed beds, from DSHS licensing records, September 2026), with capacity, specialty designations (dementia, mental health, developmental disabilities), DSHS contracts, and Medicaid status for each home. Every city, filter, and facility page is a real URL with structured data.

- [AFH Club hub](/afh-club): Start here for adult family homes in Washington.
- [What is an adult family home — and what is it called in your state?](/afh-club/what-is-an-adult-family-home): Definition plus a state-by-state table of licensing terms, agencies, and capacities.
- [Directory of licensed homes by city](/afh-club/homes): 4046 homes across 67 cities.
- [Tacoma](/afh-club/homes/tacoma): 375 licensed homes
- [Lynnwood](/afh-club/homes/lynnwood): 311 licensed homes
- [Everett](/afh-club/homes/everett): 306 licensed homes
- [Kent](/afh-club/homes/kent): 285 licensed homes
- [Federal Way](/afh-club/homes/federal-way): 275 licensed homes
- [Lakewood](/afh-club/homes/lakewood): 270 licensed homes
- [Renton](/afh-club/homes/renton): 200 licensed homes
- [Auburn](/afh-club/homes/auburn): 190 licensed homes

- [Puyallup](/afh-club/homes/puyallup): 181 licensed homes
- [Seattle](/afh-club/homes/seattle): 153 licensed homes
- [Bellevue](/afh-club/homes/bellevue): 135 licensed homes
- [Adult family home listings](/afh-club/listings): Every current AFH opportunity in Washington, in three groups.
- [Properties for sale](/afh-club/listings/properties): Houses that are licensed, formerly licensed, WABO-ready, or marketed for AFH use.
- [Businesses for sale](/afh-club/listings/businesses): Operating AFH businesses sold with or without the real estate.
- [For lease](/afh-club/listings/for-lease): Licensed and AFH-ready houses available to rent to an operator.
- [Buying & selling an AFH](/afh-club/buying-selling): How AFH real estate and business transfers (CHOW) work.
